overview: The Warfront Basin is the contested center of Hollowshade Moor’s tribal conflict.
history: The basin has been a battlefield for generations.
Owlbears, Sonic Wolves, and Grimlings each claim ancestral rights.
Territorial control shifts frequently due to raids and counterattacks.
Vah Shir scouts monitor the basin from distant ridges.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, warfront activity intensified.
hooks: A warband leader rallies troops for a major push.
A barricade collapses during a skirmish.
A faction unexpectedly retreats, shifting control.
